prompt: What were the top 5 Billboard songs by musical groups in the year 1985?
answer:
The top five **Billboard Year-End Hot 100 songs of 1985 by musical groups or duos** were:

1. **“Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go” — Wham!** (#3 overall)  
2. **“I Want to Know What Love Is” — Foreigner** (#4)  
3. **“Out of Touch” — Daryl Hall & John Oates** (#6)  
4. **“Everybody Wants to Rule the World” — Tears for Fears** (#7)  
5. **“Money for Nothing” — Dire Straits** (#8)

This treats **“Careless Whisper”** as a George Michael solo credit, as it is listed on the year-end chart. If counted under Wham!, it would rank first.
